name: Global Business Hub Tokyo
address: Tokyo 100-0004 Otemachi Financial City Grand Cube 3F, 1-9-2 Otemachi, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
accessSummary: Directly connected to Otemachi Station (Hanzomon Line, Chiyoda Line, Marunouchi Line, Tozai Line, Toei Mita Line) / Directly connected underground from JR Tokyo Station
hours: Weekdays 9:00-21:00 (closed Sat, Sun & holidays). The office is accessible 24 hours. The facility may close temporarily for equipment maintenance and inspection
notice: Meeting rooms and event space cannot be booked on their own (a facility for office tenants)

rooms.name: Field (Event Space)
rooms.note: Can be used for seminars and workshops of up to 200 people. Meeting format in a U-shape using 1 side, or classroom format (about 100 people) using 3 sides. When no event is booked, it is used as a coworking space

ops.restaurants: On the 1st floor and the 1st basement floor of the same building (Otemachi Financial City Grand Cube) there are restaurants, cafes and convenience stores. The official guide says they can be used for anything from everyday lunches to dining with important guests. (Source: https://www.gbh-tokyo.or.jp/access/)
